raw_html: [[Proof Against Disease| Proof Against Disease +8]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Proof Against Disease| Proof Against Disease +8]]:''' This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +8 [[Enhancement bonus]] to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).
